title: Hom cochains into a single object: evaluation, differential and coboundaries
statement: Let C be a preadditive category with a zero object, K an integer cochain complex, X an object, and p,q,n integers with p+n=q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Cochain.toSingleEquiv identifies degree-n cochains from K to X[q] with maps K^p to X. The inverse toSingleMk has component at (p,q) equal to a followed by singleObjXSelf.inv. If p-prime+n-prime=q, the differential of toSingleMk(a) in degree n-prime is (n-prime).negOnePow times toSingleMk(K.d(p-prime,p) followed by a). With p0+1=p and K.d(p0,p) followed by a zero, Cocycle.toSingleMk constructs the corresponding cocycle and every such cocycle is so obtained. With p+1=p1, this cocycle is a coboundary if and only if there exists b:K^p1 to X with K.d(p,p1) followed by b equal to a.
